AGENDA
  ALHAMBRA YOUTH COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING

  Alhambra Public Library
  Conference Room
  101 S. First Street, Alhambra, CA 91801

  Tuesday, February 11th, 2020 - 6:00 p.m.

Commissioners  Members Ex Officio
Tracy Duong  Michael Macias,
Carolina Esmerio  Director of Parks & Recreation
Isabella Garcia
Valerie Gonzalez
Andrea Gutierrez  Vincent Hon,
Miranda Guzman  Recreation Supervisor
Wuzhi Lou
Jaylen Luc
Selina Martinez
Sophia Olmeda
Madeline Placido
Meghan Webster
Winston Yan

We welcome you to the Youth Commission meeting.

If you wish to address the Commission during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s card and
give it to the secretary. The maximum time for addressing the Commission is five minutes. If
you wish to address the Commission on an item which appears on the agenda, your comments will
be heard during the Commission’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the Commission
on a subject which does not appear on the agenda but related to recreation or community service,
you may make your presentation under agenda item VII. Please be advised that the Commission
cannot, under the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, take action on any item which does
not appear on the agenda.

When making your presentation, please give your name and address for the record. Please make
your statement as brief as possible. Thank you.

I.  Roll Call

II.  Flag Salute

III.  Minutes of the Last regular meeting held November 12, 2019
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes of November 12, 2019
  *Note: you must have attended the meeting in order to vote on the minutes.

 IV.  Discussion Regarding Spring Eggstravaganza Volunteer Opportunity

V.  Discussion Regarding Future Special Events for 2020

VI.  Oral Communications

VII.  Commission Orals

VIII.  Adjournment

Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business described
hereinabove are on file in the Department of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 South
First Street, Alhambra, California and are available for public inspection during regular office
hours which are 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday.

Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the
meeting described herein, he or she may contact Mr. Michael Macias, Director of Parks &
Recreation, either in person at the Department of Parks & Recreation or by telephone at
626-570-5044.
